Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXXXII OF 2002
THAL DEVELOPMENT
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Thal Development Act, 1949
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 13th December, 2002]
No. Legis.13-49/2002, dated
13-12-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab- is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called The Thal Development
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of
July, 1982.

Amendment in section 1 of Act XV of 1949

ORDINANCE LXXXII OF 2002
THAL DEVELOPMENT
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Thal Development Act, 1949
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 13th December, 2002]
No. Legis.13-49/2002, dated
13-12-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab- is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 1 of
Act XV of 1949.--In the said Act, for subsection (2) of section 1, the
following shall be substituted:--
"(2) It
extends to the districts of Mianwali, Bhakkar, Muzaffargarh, Layyah and
Khushab; provided that the Provincial Government may by notification extend all
or any of the provisions of this Act to any other part of the Province of the
Punjab."
